# railgun-xv (R7, f78000d)
Static WebGPU/three r187 piece. Host root = this folder (index.html at the root). GitHub Pages: push this folder to a branch root (or /docs), enable Pages on it; .nojekyll is included. Needs HTTP (ESM) — open via Pages, not file://. WebGPU browser (Chrome/Edge); WebGL2 fallback. Query flags: ?demo=0 (no attract), ?bg=graphite|sky|stroggos|space, ?off=post, ?cinepx=0.75.
